item: World discovery waits for the unjudged candidates and a trial finds the candidate's own feed (R773 (2)-(4))
summary: The ride-along pauses while 2,000 or more candidates wait for a first verdict and resumes by itself below it; a country with 500 or more waiting is passed over and asked again once it drains; nothing is deleted. A feedless candidate's trial reads its home page for same-site feed links (at most 2, nothing guessed) before the sitemap, fetching only same-site entries. Judging takes untried first, then known feeds, then country gaps; the queue panel shows the gate, held countries and the time to clear the line at the measured pace, or says there is no estimate.
